title: Refining LLM-based Directed Test Input Generation via Runtime Value Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2608.07926v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Despite their remarkable capabilities, LLM-based directed input generation produces off-target test inputs when their underlying hypotheses on the target program's behaviors are incorrect. To effectively ground LLM-based directed input generation in actual program behaviors, we propose ReDig, a runtime feedback-guided framework for iterative refinement of LLM-based directed input generation. When a generated input fails to reach a given target code location, ReDig conducts a postmodern analysis to identify incorrect hypotheses by comparing expected runtime values and their actual runtime values observed in the off-target test execution. ReDig utilizes the postmortem analysis result as feedback to refine the inference context, guiding the subsequent test generations toward the target location. translated_title: 通过运行时值反馈改进基于大语言模型的定向测试输入生成
translated_abstract: 尽管基于大语言模型（LLM）的定向输入生成具有出色的能力，但当其对目标程序行为的潜在假设不正确时，会产生偏离目标的测试输入。为了有效地将基于LLM的定向输入生成建立在实际程序行为的基础上，我们提出了ReDig，一个运行时反馈引导的框架，用于迭代改进基于LLM的定向输入生成。当生成的输入未能到达给定的目标代码位置时，ReDig会进行事后分析，通过比较预期的运行时值与在偏离目标的测试执行中观察到的实际运行时值，来识别不正确的假设。ReDig利用事后分析的结果作为反馈来改进推理上下文，引导后续的测试生成朝向目标位置。在本文中，我们展示了ReDig的进行中的研究工作，并通过四个案例研究说明了运行时反馈引导的改进是如何运作的。
tldr: 提出了ReDig框架，通过比较预期运行时值与实际运行时值的事后分析反馈，迭代改进基于LLM的定向测试输入生成，引导测试输入到达目标代码位置。
en_tdlr: ReDig is a runtime feedback-guided framework that iteratively refines LLM-based directed test input generation by conducting postmortem analysis comparing expected and actual runtime values, guiding subsequent test generation toward target code locations.
